name: Control Europe
desc:
🌍 Control Europe

Pick any modern European country and start your conquest!
⚔️ Capture cities, grow your army, and crush your enemies.
🏙️ Upgrade cities to boost your income and manpower.
🧪 Unlock technology to increaser your army speed and strength.
🤝 Form alliances with other nations… or backstab them when the time is right.
🗺️ Out-strategize your enemies and take control of all Europe!



🚨Private Servers have a Save/Load map feature! 🚨


👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
